description: Small and medium ferrous foundries producing grey iron / SG iron castings. Typical Indian clusters: Rajkot (Gujarat), Belgaum (Karnataka), Coimbatore (Tamil Nadu), Kolhapur (Maharashtra), Howrah (West Bengal), Batala (Punjab), Agra (Uttar Pradesh). Melting is the dominant energy consumer.

unit_processes.name: Melting (Cupola / Induction Furnace / Rotary)
unit_processes.notes: Dominant energy user. Cupola uses coke; induction uses electricity. Fuel mix depends on furnace technology.

unit_processes.name: Molding and Core Making
unit_processes.notes: Sand mixing, muller operation, core baking (small ovens).

unit_processes.name: Pouring and Casting
unit_processes.notes: Ladle heating, transport of molten metal.

unit_processes.name: Heat Treatment (Annealing, Normalizing)
unit_processes.notes: Not applicable to all foundries. Typical for machine-building supply castings.

unit_processes.name: Utilities (Compressed Air, Fume Extraction, Lighting)
unit_processes.notes: Blowers for cupola and fume extraction are major electric loads.

activities_expected.description: From DISCOM electricity bill (major cost for induction-based foundries)
Coke for cupola (if applicable) — record as coal-equivalent
Natural gas for heat treatment furnaces (if applicable)
Diesel for DG set backup and forklift
Scrap steel purchased as raw material (Scope 3)
Inbound scrap logistics and outbound castings (Scope 3)

sources: BEE Foundry Cluster Energy Efficiency Programme
The Institute of Indian Foundrymen (IIF) energy benchmark studies
Batala, Belgaum and Rajkot cluster audit reports (BEE / UNIDO)
